security_notes: CSRF enforced on every mutation via app/forms.read_form
Session cookie is HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax; Secure is OFF by default — set COLOPHON_COOKIE_SECURE=1 behind TLS
Behind a reverse proxy, uvicorn needs FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS or the proxy IP gets rate-limited (T9)
Login throttling lives in the DB (login_attempts) and survives restarts; unlock with python -m app.tools.unlock
